properties.name: TRIPP LANE SUBDIVISION - reconstructed parent (871 W Tripp Lane)
properties.parent_parcel_desc: 871 W Tripp Lane (retired pre-subdivision parcel; not in current UGRC)
properties.reconstruction_method: shapely concave_hull(ratio=0.50) of the deterministic union of the 13 child parcel polygons. The raw child union (2.155 ac) excludes the dedicated 49-ft public street ROW, which is not parcelized in UGRC; the concave hull fills that corridor deterministically from the child geometry. Hull area 2.787 ac vs official parent 2.78 ac (0.2% diff).
properties.local_feet_projection: Azimuthal equidistant centered at union centroid (lon -111.915856, lat 40.645229), meters -> US survey feet, translated to local origin at bbox minimum (minx -151.4 ft, miny -251.7 ft removed). Local planar area 2.787 ac agrees with geodesic.
properties.official_parent_source: Murray City Planning Commission minutes 2022-11-17, https://www.murray.utah.gov/Archive/ViewFile/Item/7396 (vacant 2.78-acre parcel; 12 new lots + dedicated public road)
properties.reconstruction_note: Deterministic parent reconstruction for the pre-subdivision 2.78-ac parcel at 871 W Tripp Lane: concave hull (ratio 0.5) of the union of the 13 child parcel polygons (12 lots + Parcel A) from UGRC/SLCo Parcels_SaltLake FeatureServer (EPSG:4326; valid Polygon). Geodesic hull area 2.787 ac vs official 2.78 ac stated in 2022-11-17 minutes (0.3% difference). The hull fills the dedicated 49-ft street corridor + cul-de-sac, which are not separately parcelized in UGRC. Built 2026-09-24 by GreenRush-6 (script, not model geometry).
